appearance_facts.fact: Chart title: 'Increasing River Restoration Capacity from 2018 to 2023'.
X-axis has labeled ticks for the years 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023.
A single blue line plots the capacity index over time.
The data point for 2018 is at the 2,800 level on the Capacity Index axis.
The data point for 2019 is at the 2,400 level on the Capacity Index axis.
